'''Mythosaur Hunter's Armor''' was a type of specialized [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around [[3627 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> for combating [[Mythosaur/Legends|Mythosaurs]].<ref name="Reveal" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[April 27]], [[2021]], in conjunction with the [[Mythosaur Hunter's Glaive]].<ref name="Reveal" />
